reading.title: The Missing Backpack
reading.intro_zh: 这篇短文不复述 pub 和狗的原文，而是换到一家带小花园的 cafe：主人公把背包放在身边，付 bill 时才发现不见了；一家人 looked for，最后发现是四岁的弟弟 had taken 背包到 garden 里玩，服务员 immediately 把它 returned 并 gave it back。重点练习 earlier past、looked for、returned、gave it back 和 He often does this。
passage: My family stopped at a cafe with a small play garden last Sunday. I put my backpack on the seat beside me, with my wallet zipped inside, and went to choose a cake. When the waiter brought the bill, I reached for the bag to pay, but it was gone. We looked for it under every table and asked the people nearby. Then my mother pointed at the window: my four-year-old brother had taken the backpack out to the garden and was dragging it across the grass like a sledge. A kind waiter immediately went outside. He returned a minute later and gave it back to me, still covered in grass. My brother only giggled. "He often does this," my mother sighed, "so I always keep one hand on our bags."

questions.question: Where did the narrator put the backpack at the cafe?
options: On the seat beside the narrator, with the wallet inside.
On a hook by the play-garden gate.
Under the cafe counter.
In the family's car outside.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文说 I put my backpack on the seat beside me, with my wallet zipped inside。

questions.question: When did the narrator notice the backpack was missing?
options: Before the family ordered anything.
When the waiter brought the bill and the narrator reached for the bag to pay.
After the family had got home that night.
As soon as the family sat down.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文说 When the waiter brought the bill, I reached for the bag to pay, but it was gone，这时才发现背包不见了。

questions.question: Why was the missing backpack a problem at that moment?
options: Because the cafe was about to close.
Because the waiter had lost the family's order.
Because the wallet was zipped inside it, so the narrator could not pay the bill.
Because the play-garden gate was locked.
questions.explanation_zh: 钱包 zipped inside 背包，背包不见了就 could not pay the bill，所以很尴尬。

questions.question: Who had moved the backpack, and where to?
options: The kind waiter, behind the counter.
The narrator's mother, into the family car.
Another customer, to a nearby table.
The narrator's four-year-old brother, out to the garden.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文揭示 my four-year-old brother had taken the backpack out to the garden。

questions.question: Why is the mother's last comment funny?
options: Because waiters never help with lost bags.
Because the little brother does this so often that the mother already expects it.
Because backpacks can pay bills by themselves.
Because the garden had no grass at all.
questions.explanation_zh: "He often does this" 说明弟弟经常这样，妈妈早就习惯，所以结尾轻松好笑。

writing.intro_zh: 今天抓 Lesson 18 的五个故事句式：After I had had 写更早发生的事，I had left it 说明东西原来放在哪里，As I was looking for 写寻找时被打断，In a few minutes ... returned 写短时间后的回转，gave it back to me 写归还。

patterns.title: After I had had ...
patterns.source: After I had had lunch at a village pub, I looked for my bag.
patterns.focus_zh: 用 After I had had 说明“我已经做完某件事之后，又发生了后面的事”。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写你吃完饭、上完课或完成活动后，开始寻找某个东西。
patterns.sample: After I had had dinner, I looked for my phone near the sofa.
patterns.tip_zh: 第一个 had 是过去完成时助动词，第二个 had 表示 eat / experience；不要漏掉其中一个。

patterns.title: I had left it ...
patterns.source: I had left it on a chair beside the door.
patterns.focus_zh: 用 had left it 回头解释东西在更早的时候被放在哪里。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写你原本把书包、钥匙、饭卡或笔袋放在了哪里。
patterns.sample: I had left it on my desk before the bell rang.
patterns.tip_zh: it 指代前一句已经提到的东西；后面常接 on / in / beside 等地点。

patterns.title: As I was looking for ...
patterns.source: As I was looking for it, the landlord came in.
patterns.focus_zh: 这个句式写“我正在找的时候，另一个动作发生了”，很有故事感。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写你正在找某个东西时，老师、同学、家人或店员出现了。
patterns.sample: As I was looking for my pencil case, my brother called me.
patterns.tip_zh: As I was looking for 后面接要找的东西；逗号后写突然出现或发生的动作。

patterns.title: In a few minutes ... returned
patterns.source: In a few minutes he returned with my bag.
patterns.focus_zh: 用 In a few minutes 写“过了几分钟”，再用 returned 推动故事回来。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写某人几分钟后带着你丢的东西回来了。
patterns.sample: In a few minutes, she returned with my notebook from the library.
patterns.tip_zh: returned with 后面接带回来的东西；这能让故事从紧张转向安心。

patterns.title: gave it back to me
patterns.source: He gave it back to me.
patterns.focus_zh: gave it back to me 是很实用的“把东西还给我”。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写同学、店员、家人或朋友找到了你的东西并还给你。
patterns.sample: The monitor found my ruler and gave it back to me.
patterns.tip_zh: gave it back to me 可以接在 found / picked up / brought 等动作后面。
